method.percentiles: Pooled applied actions, not averages of episode percentiles
method.outcome: Equal episode means; per-seed pairing retains repeated-condition dependence
method.stages: Host timing; stage MEANS add to mean age, percentiles do not add
method.regression: Post-hoc one-predictor OLS with intercept; leave one entire seed out. R2 denominator is pooled outcome variance; negative R2 allowed. Seed-demeaned correlations are descriptive, not independent-frame inference.
